name: m1-08-sabang-legal-map
title: Sabang's free zone runs on a 2000 law with no national parent body, so customs, land, ports and routes each answer to a different ministry.
sourceLine: Source: UU 37/2000; UU 11/2006 Ps 162, 172–173; Perpres 11/2010; Habanusantara, Jul 2026; Waspada (LBH Kantara suit), 24 Sep 2025; Kompas, 14 Nov 2025; Norton Rose Fulbright (Hainan), Dec 2025. [634][614][632][637][635][651]
